description: Make a trigger that fires more often than is useful quieter, keeping its state (no new baseline, no fire again for a condition that already holds): check less often, wait longer after a fire, require the condition to hold longer, allow fewer fires, or pause it. It is the one change allowed while handling a fire, and then only for the trigger that fired; the user is told what changed and why. Anything that makes a trigger more sensitive goes through the user and trigger_update.

check_every.description: Check no more often than this, such as 15m. Only longer than now.

cooldown.description: After a fire, wait this long before the next one, such as 1h. Only longer than now.

for.description: State triggers: how long the condition must hold before it fires, such as 5m. Only longer than now.

max_fires.description: Stop after this many fires in total. Only lower than now.

pause.description: Pause the trigger until the user resumes it.

reason.description: Why, in one sentence the user will read, such as: fired 14 times in the last hour on the same flapping health check.

trigger_id.description: The trigger id, as shown by trigger_list.

name: trigger_tune
